intervention: Official FlashBlock s2 tau2 plus no-reuse decomposition control; no training.

No heldout test evaluation or next stage without new GPT task.
required_outputs: Versioned setup/build scripts, focused validation CLI, formal-test-ids.json and actual run commits.
